events.title: Hip Prov | A Night of Improv Games and Musical Challenges
events.summary: Experience a high-energy improv show featuring comics and improvisers in games and musical challenges. This event has a special theme celebrating Stevie Wonder, with local talent providing beats and judging.

evidence.description: Hip-Prov is a high-energy improv show, where comics and improvisers compete in improv games and musical challenges. Local beatbox extraordinaire Stevie Soul provides the beats in freestyle challenges and celebrity impressionist Michael McDaniel judges each round. Audience members win prizes provided by our proud sponsors Good Helpers Heating & Cooling and SYS Custom Etching and Engraving. This month's show has a special theme...ALL THINGS STEVIE WONDER!!
